changes_from_v1: 2026-10-11 hardening (docs/audits/2026-10-11-blackswan/2-overfitting.md): 1.6 trial count = max(dsr_inputs.trials, provenance.trials.count + battery candidates, research-service ledger count for the kind) + others, trials ledger cross-check, V[SR] floor; 1.13 synthetic-view cap enforced by AlphaKeel; 1.14 review-credential only, min_closed 5 -> 20, unregistered runs and OOS window reuse fail; 1.15 same pack as the IS pack; 1.16 null pack_accept_partial fails; 3.10 counts every same-kind strategy that ever entered paper; new information-only 3.11. Strategies registered under v1 keep their own v1 copy (thresholds are not retroactive). 2.1 (blackswan fix program, 3-survivorship-pit P0-1 and 2-overfitting P1-7): new 1.18 research-universe point-in-time-ness (data lock universe.selection / universe.survivorship; a universe that does not exclude survivors caps the G1 grade at C), new 1.19 undeclared numeric literals (provenance.fixed_literals), 1.9 also checks the relative width of every robust interval itself (>= 0.2); strategies registered under v2 or v1 keep their own copy (1.18 / 1.19 are optional items). 2.2 (research/judgement review 2026-10-11, docs/audits/2026-10-11-blackswan/review-research.md): AlphaKeel judges instead of reading the researcher's self-report. 1.3-1.5 also need the research service's own conservative-fill net (service_runs verified against the service run records, which also fix the IS pack); 1.6 counts fixed_literals, the ledger excludes review-credential runs and other lineages, a broken ledger fails, and service_runs must be registered and verified; 1.9 every side of every robust interval at least 20% (identical in the VT precheck); 1.12 permutation test forced when the IR restricts its universe (excluded_bases, bases whitelist the battery traded outside of); 1.13 synthetic-quote cap from the IS pack data lock; 1.14 only conservative-fill validations (spread floor >= 5 bp on synthetic quotes, capital cost charged, net_of_capital_cost, fees_override not below the account fee), the OOS consumption account counts every review-credential run of the same lineage whether registered or not; 1.18 a survivor side (survivors_*, partial_from_archive) is a direct FAIL (no more PASS-but-cap-C), 1.18 / 1.19 are required items from 2.1 on; 1.19 exemptions by position not by value; 3.6 baseline includes the conservative extra cost. Strategies registered under 2.1 or earlier keep their own copy. 2.4 (financial-grade audit 2026-10-11, F06-F10): 3.1 counts only FULL UTC days (no gap between consecutive marks above max_gap_hours, boundaries included), also requires max mark gap <= max_gap_hours, first mark within max_gap_hours of the paper start and the last mark no older than max_tail_hours; paper daily returns never difference across calendar gaps (non-contiguous pairs are dropped and counted); 3.9 requires the matched scan-frame IR-ledger replays of THIS strategy to cover every input frame (seq range) the paper journal's marks used, with no hole and no mismatching replay inside it (coverage of the paper input frames by matched replays, NOT a per-event comparison with the paper journal); 1.6 DSR and 1.8 bootstrap are also recomputed from the research service run's own daily equity (must pass on both; the lower bound is min(reported, recomputed)); review-credential validations count only when the research service lists the same run_id and credential_id; 1.7/1.9-1.11 stay as reported by VT, not recomputed. Strategies registered under 2.3 or earlier keep their own copy; the new 3.1 keys are back-filled (AK_SIDE_KEYS).
note: Thresholds are decimal strings; a ratio threshold is {"num": n, "den": d} and compares exactly (no rounding). Canonical home: docs/contracts/validation/protocol.json (exported to VT with the research contract, pinned). Every item id is implemented in crates/strategy-registry/src/verdict.rs; an unknown or missing id makes the protocol invalid (fail closed). VT's research-side precheck (agent/alphakeel_research/precheck.py) reads the same file from the exported contract and evaluates only the items marked research_side.
